1000MODS 2026

Σάββατο 7 Μαρτίου στις 20:00 | Floyd

The riff lands like a geological event. Floyd's stage holds the kind of weight that only builds when a band has spent years earning their place at the top of a scene. 1000mods prepares to remind Athens that Greek stoner rock has reached international altitude.

The band from Chiliomodi — the Peloponnese town that gave them half their name — has grown from local phenomenon to international touring act. Their sound operates in the intersection of Black Sabbath worship and desert rock expansiveness, riffs thick enough to stand on and grooves that stretch toward infinity. Albums like "Repeated Exposure to..." have placed them on festival lineups across Europe alongside the genre's originators.

Stoner rock rewards patience. The songs build gradually, riffs repeating and mutating until the hypnotic effect takes hold. 1000mods understands this — their sets develop across hours rather than through individual peaks. The experience is cumulative, the full impact arriving when you've surrendered to the tempo.

Floyd's room provides the acoustic power this band requires. The venue opened in 2023 and has established itself as one of Athens' primary spaces for heavy music — sound system capable of handling the low frequencies that define stoner rock, capacity that allows real room for the crowd to move and breathe.

The audience tonight represents a cross-section of Greek heavy music devotees. Fans who've followed 1000mods from their first Chiliomodi shows mix with newer converts drawn by festival appearances. The aesthetic runs toward band shirts, denim, comfortable boots — the practical uniform of people who came to headbang and stay late.

If you need variety or uptempo energy, stoner rock's meditative weight will test your patience. The grooves run slow, the songs extend, the intensity operates through repetition rather than surprise. But if you've been waiting for Greek rock that can stand alongside the international heavyweights — if you want to experience riffs measured in continental time — Floyd holds what you need.

1000mods at Floyd — Greek stoner rock at its heaviest, riffs built to outlast time itself.
